dashboard.title: Adjuster Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Review {brand}'s proposals and approve or reject each claim.
dashboard.footer: {count, plural, one {# claim shown} other {# claims shown}}

submit.title: New Claim
submit.description: Upload the claim PDF. {brand} will extract the customer, policy, date and impact of the incident, then propose a decision for you to review.
submit.analyzing: {brand} is analyzing the document. This may take 10 to 60 seconds…
submit.successMessage: {brand} analyzed the claim and proposed a decision.
submit.pipelineErrorMessage: {brand} could not complete the document analysis.

reasoning.title: Review Conversation
reasoning.summary: After analyzing the document and the linked policy, I suggest you {verb} this claim.

action.title: Adjuster Decision
action.reasonPlaceholderApprove: Explain why you confirm this decision. Minimum 20 characters (auditable).
action.reasonPlaceholderReject: Explain why you are rejecting. Minimum 20 characters (auditable).
action.successMessage: The decision has been recorded on file #{id}.
action.resolvedHint: This claim has already been resolved.
action.notActionableHint: Wait for the AI pipeline to finish before reviewing.
action.reasonTooShortMessage: You need at least {min} characters explaining the decision.

customer.outOfCoverage: The incident on {date} falls outside this policy's valid period.
customer.policyMissing: Policy #{id} doesn't appear under this customer
customer.policyMissingHint: Possible data discrepancy — please check with the support team.

unexpected.title: Unexpected error
unexpected.message: We couldn't complete the operation. Please try again.

network.title: No connection to server
network.message: Could not reach the backend. Make sure the orchestrator is running.

rateLimited.title: Too many actions in a short time

statusTitles.403: You don't have permission for this action

rules.reason_too_short: The reason must have at least 20 characters explaining the decision.
rules.reason_has_control_chars: The reason may only contain text and standard whitespace.
rules.actor_rate_limited: You've performed too many actions in a short time. Wait a few seconds before trying again.
